8-Day Jordan Adventure: Petra, Wadi Rum & Aqaba
summary:
The 8-Day Jordan Tour covers the country from Amman to the Red Sea, combining archaeological sites, biblical landmarks and desert scenery within a compact overland route. Visit Jerash and the Desert Castles before continuing through Madaba, Mount Nebo and Kerak to Petra. From there, travel into Wadi Rum before reaching Aqaba, with the Dead Sea adding another distinct landscape to the journey before it concludes.
With private transportation connecting each stage, the itinerary avoids reliance on scheduled group transfers between destinations. The package operates year-round and includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees, transfers and the scheduled sightseeing throughout the route.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Amman, Jerash and Dead Sea
itinerary.text: Visit Amman and explore the famous Roman Theater, Amman Citadel, and Folklore Museum. Continue to Jerash and discover its impressive Roman ruins, colonnaded streets, and temples. Later, drive to the Dead Sea and enjoy time to float in its salty waters. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Desert Castles Tour
itinerary.text: Visit the Desert Castles in eastern Jordan. Explore Qusayr Amra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its fresco paintings and zodiac dome. Continue to Qasr Kharana and the historic fortress of Qasr Al-Azraq. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Mt. Nebo – Madaba – Kerak – Petra
itinerary.text: Visit Mount Nebo, where Prophet Moses viewed the Promised Land. Enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley, the Dead Sea, Jericho, and Jerusalem. Continue to Madaba to see the famous 6th-century mosaic map at the Saint George Church. Drive along the historic King's Highway and stop at Wadi Mujib for panoramic views. Then visit the impressive Kerak Castle before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra Visit
itinerary.text: Explore Petra, Jordan’s famous red-rose city and ancient Nabataean capital. Walk through the Siq to reach the impressive Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Optional horse ride available at the entrance. Enjoy free time to explore Petra’s temples, tombs, and ancient ruins at your own pace. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum – Aqaba
itinerary.text: Drive to Wadi Rum, one of the world’s most spectacular desert landscapes. Enjoy a 4x4 jeep safari through canyons, sand dunes, and ancient Nabataean rock inscriptions. Continue to Aqaba on the Red Sea. Overnight in Aqaba.

itinerary.title: Aqaba Leisure Day
itinerary.text:
Free day in Aqaba to relax and enjoy the Red Sea resort atmosphere.
Optional activities include swimming, snorkeling, diving, or exploring the city and local markets.
Overnight in Aqaba.

itinerary.title: Departure from Aqaba
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Transfer to King Hussein International Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Jordan Tour covers Amman, Jerash, Madaba, Aqaba, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea. This private journey allows travelers to experience Jordan's ancient cities, biblical sites, stunning desert landscapes, Red Sea coastline, and world-famous archaeological treasures. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Jordan Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,295 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire itinerary. You will travel in a comfortable private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, allowing flexibility and convenience while exploring Jordan.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near the destinations visited during the tour.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides may be available at selected sites such as Petra if requested. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general travel information throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who prefer the flexibility and privacy of independent travel while still benefiting from organized transportation and carefully planned sightseeing.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, desert landscapes, and historic towns. Petra requires a fair amount of walking, while Wadi Rum includes outdoor desert experiences.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Petra, Wadi Rum, Aqaba, and the Dead Sea?
faqs.a: Petra is Jordan's most famous UNESCO World Heritage Site, featuring the Treasury and remarkable rock-carved monuments. Wadi Rum offers breathtaking desert scenery and jeep safari adventures. Aqaba is Jordan's gateway to the Red Sea, known for its beaches and marine life. The Dead Sea provides the unique experience of floating in mineral-rich waters.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-Day Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 8-Day Jordan Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be fully customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include local guides, add activities in Aqaba or Wadi Rum, or modify the itinerary to match your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
